metadata.title: Electrical Department, Power Distribution & Grid Facilities in Pune
metadata.description: Comprehensive dataset containing geographical coordinates, operational roles, contact information, and jurisdictions for municipal electrical departments (PMC & PCMC), Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited (MSEDCL/Mahavitaran) circle and division offices, Maharashtra State Electricity Transmission Company Limited (MSETCL/Mahatransco) regional facilities, and the Government of Maharashtra Electrical Inspectorate.

municipal_electrical_departments_and_con.name: PMC Electrical Department Central Head Office
municipal_electrical_departments_and_con.role_and_responsibilities: Apex civic body managing public street lighting network, solar power rooftop installations, electrification of civic hospitals, schools, gardens, crematoriums, electric vehicle (EV) public charging infrastructure, and decorative illumination.
municipal_electrical_departments_and_con.address: Second Floor, Sawarkar Bhavan, Congress House Road, Shivajinagar

municipal_electrical_departments_and_con.name: PMC Central Street Lighting SCADA & CCMS Control Room
municipal_electrical_departments_and_con.role_and_responsibilities: Centralized Control and Monitoring System (CCMS) operating over 150,000 smart LED streetlights across Pune, automated fault detection, timer switching, and energy conservation tracking.
municipal_electrical_departments_and_con.address: 3rd Floor, PMC Main Building Complex, Shivajinagar

municipal_electrical_departments_and_con.name: PCMC Electrical Department Headquarters
municipal_electrical_departments_and_con.role_and_responsibilities: Citywide public illumination, electrical maintenance of municipal water works, sewage treatment plants, civic auditoriums, traffic signal synchronization, and green energy initiatives in Pimpri-Chinchwad.
municipal_electrical_departments_and_con.address: PCMC Main Administrative Building, Mumbai - Pune Road, Pimpri Colony
